★ Request
Display Curren Bouquetd'or (Winter Uniform)
Bouquet is holding a coffee (prop1064_00).

Sub-trai... wait, Trainer!
Ah, looks like you're tied up. ...You seem busy, so never mind.
(......If that's the case... then—I will!)
(Past track record is—...blank? Umamusume trained—none.)

(—If I recall, that was the head trainer
of the team they belonged to back as an assistant trainer...)

So... like this, right?! —Whoa, the propulsion feels completely different!
Ehehe, I bet I can beat my record with this!
I see... So that's why you're always acting on behalf of the Umamusume...

(Ah...—what a truly warm person.
Completely and purely devoted to the Umamusume—)
Would you please... become my Trainer...?!

Really?! Then please spare some time after training!
Sorry for intruding, see you later!

(I think I understand. Because they're such a kind Trainer—
She knows... they'll accept her without fail. That's why.)

I-Is it really all right...? Th-Then... if you insist...
Here is today's menu! Sorry to trouble you, and thank you!

(At first, she was almost crushed under the shadow of defeat—
and now, she's smiling, overflowing with confidence.)
What about the fans who watched the race—?

Was that someone from the team you used to belong to?
Fufu, you're really well-loved, aren't you?

—You're such an exceptional Trainer.
And yet—...none of that shows in your official record—

(...An assistant trainer's job is team support, after all.
They have so many opportunities to hear reports from Umamusume and interact with them.)
I understand that, but you need to think about your own career as well.
—Even though you're such a wonderful Trainer...
—That's just how it goes when you're an assistant trainer, isn't it...?

"Trainer <username> was the one who guided her!
We couldn't have entrusted her to anyone else. I'm grateful from the bottom of my heart!"

—...Ah, she won! Oh, thank goodness—!
Ah, Trainer showed up on screen. Fufufu, they look so happy.

(—Oh, wow. Watching it, I couldn't tell at all.
Their analysis and counter-strategies came out so smoothly, too—)
————No way...

(Just like the newspapers... it's not really being talked about. It can't be helped, but
their achievements end up hidden in the shadow of the senior trainer...)
(When you—deserve a golden bouquet of your own.)
—U-Um...—I-Is there something on my face?

(There's nothing written about Trainer at all...
Even though both she and the senior trainer mentioned them in their comments—)

(...A bouquet. Victory—only an Umamusume can deliver that.
—Only an Umamusume can present it.)
(Trainer is scouting for...—ah.)
...Putting the Umamusume first—

(So you used to serve as an assistant trainer.
Ah... is that why you're so perceptive to our subtle feelings?)

(So many Umamusume look up to you. Trainer—
you deserve to receive so many more bouquets.)

"Trainer <username> was the one who guided her!
We couldn't have entrusted her to anyone else. I'm grateful from the bottom of my heart!"

(—The Trainer directory is...—found it.
...Eh? A rookie Trainer? —Ah, but...)

<username>, aren't you taking on too much work?
You have the important task of finding your own assigned Umamusume, too, remember?

"Yes, I watched the broadcast. She won just as she was meant to!
Though she developed a bit of a mental block after a losing streak for a while—"
The day of the Fukushima Kinen—

Aaaagh, my legs gave out before the end...
Um, what part do you think went wrong?

Yes, I'm all right. I've decided to take my time and not rush my thoughts about racing.
—Thank you for your concern.

(—Treating my desire to run as something precious, with utmost respect.
...There is no trainer out there as kind as this.)

...Well, if you put it like that,
I really can't say anything more, can I?

(And yet, why... is that brilliance buried away?
Why is that wonderful quality not being celebrated?)

(That's why—you never overlooked even the smallest changes in me.
Gently, quietly—like a flower—nestling close beside my heart.)

"I hadn't produced results at 2000m and wondered if this time would be any good, but
thanks to Trainer <username>, I was able to win!"

Ah... yes, that's right. When you first joined the team,
I scolded you pretty harshly, didn't I? Telling you to always prioritize the Umamusume above all else.
—Trainer!

To be trusted this much even by senior trainers—
You really are an exceptional Trainer, after all.
(—I wonder if the newspaper has arrived yet.)

Aaaah, shoot! I completely forgot about today's race entry deadline!!
And of all times, when my trainer is away on a business trip! But my training—
Excuse me—!

Trainer, hello.
—Are you here to observe?

—Everyone, that's three sets done! We'll record times after a break!
There are trainers here on scouting rounds, so let's give it our all!

—Found it.
Let's see, yesterday's article on the Fukushima Kinen is—
